# The compile area's gaps: FuzzCompile, FuzzParse, FuzzConfig, FuzzTypeScriptParity and FuzzDeclarationIdentity.
# Each minimized input in testdata/fuzz/<target>/ has a corpus line; the key of the
# oracle it breaks has a line too, so other inputs that meet the same gap skip.
# target              key                                        owner     what is missing
FuzzCompile           corpus:match-flow-limit-cubic              compiler  hang: a match of N literal arms over an N-literal union checks in O(N^3) (500 arms: 0.7 s, 1000: 5.7 s, 2000: 48 s; the same TypeScript switch: 10 ms); the reproduction is case match-flow-limit.fail grown to 3,000 arms, so it outlasts the probe on any host until the check is fixed

FuzzDeclarationIdentity feature:declaration-identity             compiler  Chapter 1, Declaration output: "Declarations are exactly what idiomatic Effect TypeScript would declare." Renamed ordinary TypeScript currently promotes inline import types into root Effect imports and lifts plain functions to Effects; corpora runtime-effect-import and plain-arrow
FuzzDeclarationIdentity corpus:runtime-effect-import              compiler  Chapter 1: "Declarations are exactly what idiomatic Effect TypeScript would declare." Runtime.makeRunMain changes import("effect/Effect").Effect to Effect.Effect and adds Effect to the root import, the prelude family of opencode-1, which 60e2658d fixed without fixing this; lane migfix-opencode
FuzzDeclarationIdentity corpus:plain-arrow                        compiler  Chapter 1: "Declarations are exactly what idiomatic Effect TypeScript would declare." export const f = () => "ok" declares () => Effect.Effect<string, never, never> plus an Effect import in .vibe, () => string in stock TypeScript; VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript, but the compiler still emits its Effect form (exit:called lines in vip.txt); lane core-land (VIP-1 flip)
